summary: Noether R122-based Paper 39 source-fidelity candidate for printed pp.189-194. This package supersedes the earlier R121-based P39 page-level drops by applying confirmed P39 repairs on top of the R122 German cumulative.
verification_summary: Based on Noether_R122_20260623.zip rather than the earlier R121 cumulative.
Replaces only Paper 39 with a source-checked German block for printed pp.189-194.
Two XeLaTeX passes produced a 457-page cumulative candidate PDF.
Log scan reported no fatal error, emergency stop, undefined control sequence, or missing-character report.
One overfull hbox remains at the source-shaped display of formula (1); this is retained as a layout issue, not hidden.
limitations: Candidate review package only; not a promoted canonical branch unless later accepted/reconciled.
Paper 39 printed pp.189-194 only; does not certify surrounding Noether papers or downstream translations.
Not a critical edition, not whole-corpus certification, and not final Noether closure.
recommended_next_action: Use as the preferred P39 source-fidelity candidate over earlier R121-based P39 page drops. Reconcile into the current German branch before any multilingual propagation.
